null_policy: Unknown values remain null. Missing metrics must never be converted to zero. Conflicting untimed cumulative metrics must not be collapsed into a fabricated canonical value.
source_time_policy: published_at describes the X post. source_snapshot_at describes the corroborating page snapshot when known. metric_as_of describes the metric observation when known. A crawler cache timestamp must not be silently substituted for either metric_as_of or published_at.
sampling_policy: A matched-comparison candidate is not a low-distribution control by default. It becomes a control only when comparable distribution evidence supports that label. Unresolved author/topic leads remain sidecar discovery leads rather than admitted canonical posts.
dedup_key: status_id when available; otherwise unresolved mirror leads remain outside the admitted canonical set
notes: Collector output only. No drafting, publishing, or formula promotion. Historical author-pool metrics are discovery seeds only and must never be copied to new posts. PUBLIC_X_AGGREGATOR and mirror evidence remain explicitly provenance-scoped and are not equivalent to direct original X rendering.
